title: NICAP's founding as a possible link to the 1956 cutoff

tellings.quote: that's when NICAP formed, which was the first civilian UFO research program.

plain: Around 1956, the same time as a break or cutoff that comes up in his talk with the astronomer Beatriz Villarroel, a group called NICAP was founded, which Michels calls "the first civilian UFO research program," meaning a private group of citizens studying UFO reports. Michels raises the timing himself, without a source, as a possible link between that cutoff and the start of public UFO research.
